divisions.name: Harness Core
divisions.purpose: Stewards the product API spine: session, prompt assembly, tools, agent, the agent loop, LLM routing, and subagent delegation.

divisions.name: Proving Ground
divisions.purpose: Operates the harness against real bench scenarios recorded under examples/headless-agent/tests.

divisions.name: Verification
divisions.purpose: Runs the verify-* scripts that gate changed source before it ships.

divisions.name: Judging
divisions.purpose: Decides pass or fail at each named CI gate.

divisions.name: Curation & Data
divisions.purpose: Curates the Agent Note corpus and fixture datasets, and keeps score of usage for the observatory.

divisions.name: Program Departments
divisions.purpose: Coordinates cross-cutting package groups as departments of one program.

divisions.name: Code Safety
divisions.purpose: Reviews target repositories for secrets, injection, access, data, dependency, and platform risk, per language.

divisions.name: Knowledge
divisions.purpose: Keeps the repository's reusable skills current and discoverable.

divisions.name: Governance
divisions.purpose: Owns process standards: labels, stacking, dependencies, vendoring, licensing, and translation pairing.

divisions.name: Observatory
divisions.purpose: Watches session telemetry, token spend, and query surfaces across runs.
